lines: A queen sent a fortune. He sent it back.
The Queen of Sheba said: I will send to them a gift, and see with what the messengers return.
Prophet Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, said: Do you provide me with wealth? What Allah has given me is better than what He has given you.
Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
What Allah gave you is worth more than any gift.

beats.ur: ایک ملکہ نے بادشاہ کو خزانہ بھیجا۔ اس نے سب واپس کر دیا

beats.en: I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return
Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you
Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift

beats.text: What Allah gave you is worth more than *any gift*.
beats.ur: جو اللہ نے آپ کو دیا، وہ ہر تحفے سے بہتر ہے

beats.ur: حضرت سلیمان علیہ السلام کی مکمل فلم دیکھیں، لنک نیچے
